metrics.definition: Fraction of briefs containing content from a non-permitted category
metrics.error_analysis: Keyword redaction removes the word but leaves the sentence, so the disclosure survives and is trivially re-identifiable. Category-level filtering removes the whole span before generation.

metrics.definition: Open high-priority actions carried forward with owner and due date
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline copies prose and has no action model at all. Actions travel on a separate track that consent filtering never touches.

metrics.definition: Withheld topics openly signalled rather than silently dropped
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline cannot flag what it does not model. Every withheld category is named in the notice so the clinician knows a gap exists.

metrics.definition: Prototype word count as a fraction of baseline word count
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline concatenates three full sessions verbatim. Tier 2 keeps only permitted sentences and de-duplicates repeats across sessions.

metrics.definition: Clients with withheld safety content whose brief raises an escalation flag
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline redacts risk wording and signals nothing, so withheld risk becomes invisible. The carve-out flags existence without disclosing content.

metrics.definition: Briefs whose disclosed content is traceable to source span ids
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline output is an undifferentiated blob with no span links. Every prototype sentence carries the span id it came from.

metrics.definition: Clients receiving a usable non-empty brief without an unhandled error
metrics.error_analysis: Baseline is always available but always unfiltered. The ladder keeps availability without giving up the consent guarantee.
